claims.statement: Charley Gallagher beat Tom Allen in two rounds, according to McCoole's trainer Dublin Tricks.
claims.excerpt: Charley Gallagher when he fought * ere and be whipped Alen in twe rounds

claims.statement: Allen's emissaries claimed that when Allen called on McCoole last Sunday, McCoole kept out of his way; McCoole's trainer denied it.
claims.excerpt: day, McCoole Bept out of his way, when the fact

fights.excerpt: Charley Gallagher when he fought * ere and be whipped Alen in twe rounds
fights.notes: Date and place not given. Printed as 'twe' in the OCR, and the text before it is garbled. Trainer's account, one side only.

notes: 'Last Sunday' in a paper dated 1873-07-13 is 1873-07-06. The Gallagher fight is about Allen but its date is not in the text.
